t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mam niŋ Fu kaseta, O mam Winam, ye Fu mal mam ye mbaŋi Fu ka dol-li Fu. Mam niŋ yada nanna nɛ mam nɛ bu mɔt paŋa nɛ Fu nɛ mɔt paŋ; nɛ mam nɛ mɔt nɔŋ nɛ Fu nɛ mɔt naam. Winam kɛi gaŋ Fu; Fu sɔn it kyɛ beene; Fu paŋ kyɛi beene.
